_note: The mobs, read by both editions. Things are named by their keys (see blockKey in index.html / DataKeys.cs). Times in seconds, distances in blocks.

_notes.MOBS: every mob, in the order they're spawned. type = its name in the game (its model and skins have the same name); health; speed (blocks a second); max = the most of it around at once (0: it has its own spawning, like the cow); drops = [[thing, fewest, most, chance]] dropped when it's killed (chance left out = always); growl = its voice (heard every so often and when hit); hostile = chases and attacks you (survival only), with damage (hearts' quarters a hit, or what a thrown Rock takes off), sight (how far it sees you) and reach (how close it hits from); dark = spawns anywhere dark (caves any time, open ground at night); night = only on open ground after dark; deep = only where it's pitch dark underground; burns = catches fire in daylight with nothing over its head; shamble = walks like a zombie; glow = lights itself up, so it shows at full brightness in the dark; curious = drawn to block sounds (within hearing) and torches (within lightRange); thrower = keeps between near and far and throws Rocks; snuffer = puts burning torches out; faint = never looks darker than this; scale = how much bigger than its model it's drawn; cow = a cow (see COW); animal = one of the animals of the Farming & animals update (see ANIMALS); a boar or bear also has damage and reach, for when it turns on you. grrangry is the night mob from before the Zombie: only one of the two is in the game, as ZOMBIE_READY (web) / ZombieReady (desktop) says
_notes.LAYER_BOOST: a mob from a deeper stone layer has this much more health and damage for each layer down (0.1 = 10%)
_notes.GLOOM_FADE: a Gloomling fades away (time) when someone holding a lit torch comes this close (range)
_notes.COW: cows: perChunk = breeding stops at this many in a chunk; crowdedAt = cows near (nearRange) that make it crowded; fatAt = Grain to get fat; fedMax = the most Grain that counts; happyMax = the most happiness (seconds); grazeHappy / grainHappy = happiness from grazing / Grain; grazeBelow = grazes when happiness is under this; grazeTime = how long grazing takes; mateCooldown, mateCost (happiness), calfTime (to grow up), calfGrainBoost (Grain takes this off), calfHealth; regrowMin / regrowMax = eaten grass grows back between these
_notes.ANIMALS: the animals besides the cow (their MOBS rows say animal), each with the cow's rules (see COW for what these mean): perChunk, crowdedAt, nearRange, happyMax, mateCooldown, mateCost, babyTime (the young grow up; calfTime for cows), babyFoodBoost (food takes this off), babyHealth, fedMax, foodHappy (happiness from its food). food = what it eats from your hand (right-click holding it); forage = its own foraging: time (head down), every [fewest, most] seconds, below (only while its happiness is under this), happy (what it gives). Spawning (Biomes worlds only): biomes; ground = what it stands on (water: on top of water, with land within 3); group = [fewest, most] grown ones (each after the first is young 1 time in 4; a bear comes alone, with cubs [fewest, most] cubChance of the time); nearMax = no more come while this many of it are within 80; spawnWeight = how often it is picked among those of the biome; logNear = needs a log (one of logs, if given) within this many across; minHeight = at least this far above sea level. chicken: layTime = [fewest, most] seconds from being fed to its Egg (one at a time); scratchTime = how often it scratches the empty tilled soil it stands on, fertChance = the chance a scratch fertilizes it (every scratch keeps it tilled); peckTime = how often it may peck an unripe crop it stands on or beside, peckChance = the chance it does (the crop goes back a stage; a first stage is eaten). duck: layTime as the chicken's, its Egg on the nearest dry ground within eggReach; duckRate = how much faster a crop on wet tilled soil grows with a grown duck in the water within duckReach across (a square) and 2 up or down; followRange = it comes ashore to someone holding its food this close; waterRange = ashore, it heads for water this close. deer: shyRange = it runs from you this close unless you hold its food; sowEvery, sowChance = a lucky tick every sowEvery seconds plants the sapling of the leaves it last passed (within 3) on its Grass, with open sky and no log or sapling within sowClear (it counts as natural); nibbleEvery, nibbleChance, nibbleRange = it eats a sapling this close. goat: it forages by eating a Dead Bush, or a natural leaf block with the ground at most 2 below, within 2; milkTime = seconds it stays milky after being fed (a Clay Jug used on it then gives a Jug of Milk). boar: it forages (roots) on Grass with one of logs within rootNear across: the Grass turns to Dirt, and a Truffle comes up truffleChance of the time; angerTime = seconds it goes for whoever hit it (survival). bear: prey = what it hunts (they run from a grown bear within preyFlee); huntCool = seconds after a meal (or being fed) before it is hungry; huntRange, huntHeight = how far it looks for prey; chaseTime = how long it chases one, retry = how long before it tries again; mealHappy = happiness from a kill; cubRange = it goes for you if you come this close to one of its cubs (within cubNear of it); angerTime as the boar's. A bear's kill leaves only its Feathers. In Earthlike worlds (Beta 0.1.5.5): earthBiomes are the biomes they spawn in (the plan's names; the cow's are in COW), earthGround replaces ground (the goat's: the crags' rocks and gravels too), earthLogs replaces logs, and a ground list's grass means any grassy top (the grassy soils too)
